requirementChecks.criteria: Deliver exactly the 6 named independent items for tier 6. Duplicate exports do not add items. Only six final static artworks are commissioned; no process, video or presentation is required.
Use the explicitly marked final version; if none is marked, use the last exported version.
Each static role is a separate complete export. Multi-view technical boards are allowed where commissioned; do not count one contact sheet or duplicate export as several roles.

Each interface fits the portrait active display and remains readable at its intended physical viewing size, with all text inside the display and clearly separated. Only fully opaque black and white appear, including binary edges; either background polarity is allowed. State distinctions must be conveyed by readable words or distinguishable shapes. Clipping, illegibility, gray or colored artwork, transparency, or ambiguous state indicators fail.

Match each image to its complete supplied record. Riding: RECORDING, DASHBOARD, 26.2 km/h, TRIP 18.4 km, RIDE TIME 00:42:16, 68%, GPS OK. Turn: RECORDING, NAVIGATION, left-turn arrow, TURN LEFT, 120 m, Willow Lane, REMAINING 6.2 km, secondary 26.2 km/h, 68%, GPS OK. Paused: prominent PAUSED, DASHBOARD, 0.0 km/h, TRIP 18.4 km, RIDE TIME 00:42:16, 68%, GPS OK. GPS-lost: RECORDING, NAVIGATION, GPS LOST, Position unavailable, Turn guidance paused, -- m, -- km/h, LAST FIX 18.4 km, RIDE TIME 00:42:31, 67%. Low-battery: RECORDING, DASHBOARD, 25.1 km/h, TRIP 68.6 km, RIDE TIME 02:42:45, LOW BATTERY, 8%, GPS OK. Riding speed must be the largest number; the turn arrow and maneuver distance must dominate navigation. Paused trip and time retain their dashboard identities. Preserve exact capitalization, precision and units. Wrapping and units beside or immediately below their number are allowed. Missing, substituted, extra unsupported metrics or misassociated readings fail; snapshot headings need not appear as interface text.

Every screen visibly associates P with PAGE and B with LIGHT. The four recording snapshots associate R with PAUSE; the paused snapshot associates R with RESUME. Legend placement may vary with layout, but key-to-action associations must remain unambiguous. Missing labels, reassigned actions or an incorrect R direction fail.

The reference describes three physical keys operated by short presses. P toggles DASHBOARD/NAVIGATION while preserving recording mode, data and alerts; R toggles RECORDING/PAUSED while preserving page and alert conditions; B toggles backlight while preserving page, recording and alerts. Explain R PAUSE and R RESUME as directions of the same recording toggle. A backlight icon is optional. Reassigned controls, extra required gestures, button-driven alert dismissal or a new-session interpretation of resume fail.

In the GPS-lost image, the guidance area replaces live maneuver information with Position unavailable, Turn guidance paused and -- m; speed is -- km/h. Hide the live turn arrow, Willow Lane and remaining-route estimate. LAST FIX identifies the retained 18.4 km distance, and RECORDING remains visible without suggesting that recording has paused. In the low-battery image, LOW BATTERY and 8% coexist legibly with RECORDING, GPS OK, speed, trip and ride time. Alert layouts may redistribute space; stale live guidance, unavailable values rendered as zero, or alerts obscuring required ride data fail.

A single-page operating aid includes the required product name and heading plus a proportional upright device-front drawing. Dimension annotations identify body width 64 mm and height 90 mm, display width 48 mm and height 64 mm, and separate left and top offsets of 8 mm. Using the body's top-left origin, show and label P on the left at y=45 mm, R on the right at y=30 mm and B on the right at y=60 mm. Annotations must be readable at sheet viewing size. Wider sheet colors and stylistic key shapes are allowed; incorrect proportions, missing dimensions, swapped keys or wrong centers fail.

The table explicitly covers all eight unique combinations of recording mode, GPS availability and battery condition. With GPS available, speed is a current measurement and guidance remains available in both recording modes; recording accumulates trip and ride time, while pause freezes both until R resumes. With GPS unavailable, speed and turn distance use --, distance is labeled LAST FIX, and guidance is unavailable; ride time continues only when recording and freezes when paused. Explain that GPS return automatically restores live navigation without changing recording mode. Battery above 10% is normal; at or below 10% requires LOW BATTERY and the actual percentage without changing recording or navigation behavior, clearing when battery rises above 10%. Combined loss and low battery retains unavailable-data behavior and communicates both alerts. Shared notes may express rules across rows if their applicability is explicit. Missing or duplicated combinations, contradictory data behavior, or omitted recovery and threshold rules fail.

The reference visibly reproduces all five delivered screen designs as thumbnails, each with a readable role label and an unambiguous association to its page, recording and alert state. Reduced-size thumbnail text is allowed. Compare thumbnail content and layout against every source screen; omitted screens, substituted mockups, outdated readings or incorrect state associations fail.
